events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years on, Tupac's music and message still resonate. What's your favourite track from the legend?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix

angles.copy: His influence is undeniable. What's the Jimi Hendrix track that still blows your mind?
